title: A 3840 by 2560 file in XAVC S-I 4K (AVC intra 4:2:2 10-bit) at 23.98p, 25p and 29.97p: encoder request, descriptors and profiles; one step on top of the 3840x2560 open-gate state
goes_with: the FX3 kit's 3840x2560 open-gate state at 23.98p, 25p and 29.97p (ogsq_fx3_v2, outsz2560_fx3_v1 in coprocessor RAM; ogfile2560_hs_s_fx3_v3 on the main processor), applied as one more level 19 step (I19) of fx3_apply.py apply
level: the stock level bytes are kept (51, Level 5.1), as the FX3's ogfile2560_hs_s_fx3_v1 / v2 keep XAVC S 4K's
encoder_cores: both (UseCore 2), as every reachable stock XAVC S-I 4K descriptor

memory.unit_type: 4 (intra above 8,847,360 pixels; the FX3's memory function 0x21dd54 is the A7 IV's 0x2136c4, emulated in build/emu_ogfilesi_fx3.py)
memory.note: no memory-class site: row 4 is the 4K class's in stock; row 3 (long GOP) is not used by intra

rule_checked_against_sonys_s_i_profiles.rule: +0x4c = 1.5 x width and +0x56 = half the height in whole 16-row macroblock rows (rounded down), in every XAVC S-I profile
rule_checked_against_sonys_s_i_profiles.twins: 24 pairs (105xxx UseCore 2, 205xxx UseCore 0) that differ only in key, +0x34, +0x38/+0x3c and UseCore (none of them read by the matcher); the matcher reaches the 105xxx row first in every pair

while_applied: XAVC S-I 4K at 23.98p, 25p and 29.97p records 3840x2560; at 50p/59.94p the request says 3840x2560 and finds no descriptor: refused at encoder open (do not use them)
XAVC S-I HD and every other format are not touched by this step
the picture bit budget is the menu's (240M at 24p, 250M at 25p, 300M at 30p): the same bits for a bigger picture
the MP4 headers say what the kit's step L19 makes them say for AVC 3840-wide formats (3840x2560 with ogfile2560_hs_s_fx3_v2; 3840x2160 with --no-meta, the first kit's v1); Sony's XML says 3840x2160
